PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-001.text: Token comparison must use constant-time algorithm to prevent timing side-channel extraction.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-001.assertion: forall req: auth_compare(req.token, valid_token) uses timing_safe_equal, not ===

locations.note: Uses bcrypt.compare which is timing-safe; however stem-system has no bearer token comparison — auth via Supabase JWT
supabase.auth.getUser() handles JWT verification internally; comparison safety depends on Supabase library
